r: Have you been down in the catacombs?
May I ask you a question? Do you know a way to climb over the graveyard fence to the south?
I will go and find your ladder.
I tried the ladder, but the window is locked.
The ladder is gone and the window shut.

athamyr_1.m: Yes, I have been in the catacombs beneath Fallhaven Church.

athamyr_2.m: But I'm the only one that has both the permission and the bravery to go down there.
r: How can I get permission to go down there?

athamyr_3.m: You want to go down in the catacombs? Hmm, maybe we can make a deal.

athamyr_4.m: Bring me some of that delicious cooked meat from the tavern and I will give you my permission to enter the catacombs of Fallhaven Church.
r: Here, I have cooked meat for you.

athamyr_complete_12.m: I hope you behaved well there.

athamyr_complete_2.m: You have my permission to enter the catacombs of Fallhaven Church.

athamyr_coup_10.m: No, there is no way over the fence.

r: Well, behind the fence is the shop of the tailor.
And there is always a window open.

athamyr_coup_16.m: Ah, I understand. You want to surprise your friend, the tailor.

athamyr_coup_18.m: Then I have a better idea. I am your man.
r: Great! I will thank you with a delicious piece of cooked meat.

athamyr_coup_22.m: Make it ten. Ten cooked meat.

athamyr_coup_23.m: I have to smuggle a ladder into the basement of the church, which is very risky for me.

athamyr_coup_24.m: Then you can climb through a window and reach a path right to the back of the tailor's house.
r: OK. I have ten deliciously cooked pieces of meat now.
I will go for it now.
I have ten deliciously cooked pieces of meat now.
I will go for it now.

athamyr_coup_28.m: I knew you would do that, my friend. So I have already hidden the ladder in the basement near the window.

r: Yes. And you know it perfectly well.

athamyr_coup_32.m: Well, maybe I could risk borrowing the key and unlocking the window.

athamyr_coup_34.m: Bring twenty more pieces of cooked meat. Yes, twenty should do. That's worth my risk of ending up as bonemeal.
r: I have bought the twenty cooked pieces of cooked meat.
I will go for it now.

athamyr_coup_36.m: Ohh, that smells delicious! You are a true friend.
r: Here take it. And don't forget to unlock the window.
I hope for your sake that was all.

athamyr_coup_40.m: Yes. I tidied up a bit again.

athamyr_coup_42.m: ... unlock the window again for you? No, I have enough cooked meat for a long time.
